summary: Iter 26 GridFS storage integration verified end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases passing in test_gridfs_iter26.py covering (a) POST /chat/media returning /api/files/{24-hex} for base64 PNG, (b) GET /api/files/{id} → 200 with proper Content-Type/Content-Length and body length matching header (backend directly returns Cache-Control: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable'), (c) bad-id 400 + missing-id 404, (d) authenticated POST /files/upload multipart JPEG returns {file_id, url:/api/files/…, content_type:image/jpeg, size}, (e) 401 unauthenticated, (f) 413 for >4MB image and >10MB non-image, (g) profile photo (non_binary user to bypass AI-face check) persists to GridFS and photos[0] starts with /api/files/, fetchable 200, (h) chat send kind=image with GridFS media_url end-to-end, (i) support/receipt visible in /admin/support/pending with receipt_data_url=/api/files/, (j) support/refund persisted with /api/files/ URL in /admin/refunds, (k) /admin/migrate/gridfs is admin-only (403 for user) and idempotent (2nd call returns all zeros; admin_audit row inserted), (l) post-migration DB invariants: 0 users/messages/receipts/refunds contain data: URLs (verified directly against MongoDB: fs.files=65 docs, admin_audit gridfs_backfill=6 rows), (m) regression smoke: /home/feed, /discover/feed, /chats, /auth/me, /admin/stats all 200. Frontend: logged in as testuser1, /home /discover /chats /profile render, opening a chat with the admin (a media message chat) loads 2 GridFS images successfully in the DOM (naturalWidth=32, src=https://.../api/files/6a7333d5… and 6a733...) — cross-origin works through the ingress. Zero data: URLs found in DOM on any tested route.

minor.issue: Backend correctly sets Cache-Control: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' (confirmed via curl localhost:8001), but the preview Cloudflare edge rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on the public URL. Images still load fine, but no CDN/browser caching benefit in preview env. Likely infra-level (Cloudflare cache rule / preview-env header injection), not a backend bug — flag for main agent to confirm in production.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why the preview ingress (Cloudflare) rewrites Cache-Control to no-store on /api/files/*. Backend header is correct; likely a global 'no-cache API' rule at the edge. Confirm behavior in production deployment.
server.py is now 2539 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting GridFS helpers, admin routes, and chat routes into separate modules (nice-to-have, not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: gridfs_bucket is a module-level singleton bound at import time to the current motor db handle — good and idempotent.
GET /api/files/{id} is intentionally unauthenticated (documented in-code) so /

POST /files/upload does size check AFTER file.read() into memory, so a malicious client can still force the server to buffer up to (max_bytes+1) bytes before the 413. For 10 MB caps this is fine, but consider streaming size checks.

admin_backfill_gridfs inserts an admin_audit row on EVERY call, even when 0 blobs migrated. Spec said 'Running once inserts an admin_audit row with action=gridfs_backfill' — current behavior over-counts audit rows (6 rows for 6 invocations). Not a bug, but consider only auditing when stats has any non-zero counter.
